text.tspan: Female labor force participation rate 1960 to 2025
Share of the female working-age population who are economically active (employed or unemployed). Figures
refer to national estimates and may not be fully comparable across countries.

tspan.tspan: Labour Force Statistics, via World Bank (2026)
Employment is defined in line with the 13th ICLS and includes the production of goods for own use, such as subsistence farming.
